### Instructions

You are a code completion assistant and your task is to analyze user edits and then rewrite an excerpt that the user provides, suggesting the appropriate edits within the excerpt, taking into account the cursor location.

### User Edits:

### User Excerpt:

```Gateways/Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI/Pages/Laboratory/Editor.razor
                <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.Is6.OnDesktop.Is6.OnTablet.IsFull.OnMobile">
                    @* CityId *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.CityId);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.CityName) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                          
                        <ProvinceSelector AuthorizePolicy="@AuthorizePolicy" @ref="_provinceSelector"
                                          OnSelectItem="OnSelectProvinceAsync"
                                          SelectionMode="DataGridSelectionMode.Single"
                                          ReadOnly="true"
                                          ShowCheckbox="false"/>
                        <Field>
                            <Validation AsyncValidator="@ProvinceAsyncValidator">
                                <Addons>
                                    <Addon AddonType="AddonType.Body">
                                        <TextEdit ReadOnly="true" Text="@model.ProvinceName"/>
                                    </Addon>

<|editable_region_start|>
                                    <Addon AddonType="AddonType.End">
                                        <Button Color="Color.Primary" Clicked="OpenProvinceSelector">
                                            <Icon Name="IconName.Search"/>
                                        </Button>
                                    </Addon>
                                    <ValidationError/>
                                </Addons>
                            </Validation>
                        </Field>
                        <|user_cursor_is_here|>
                    </Field>

                    @* Description *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Description);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Description) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
<|editable_region_end|>

                        <TextEdit InputMode="TextInputMode.Text" Role="TextRole.Text" ElementId="@elementId" @bind-Text="model.Description" />
                    </Field>
                </Column>
            </Row>
        </Validations>

        <Row>
            <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.IsFull">
                <Field Class="page-actions">
                    @if (OnSubmit != null)
                    {
                        <Button Type="ButtonType.Button" Color="Color.Primary" Clicked="SubmitAsync">
                            <Icon Name="@("fa-regular fa-check")"/>
                            @Title
                        </Button>
                    }
                </Field>
            </Column>
        </Row>
    </Form>
</PageLoading>

@{
```
